verdict.rationale: Mollie's MCP server exposes Payments, Payment Links, Customers, Subscriptions, and other APIs to AI clients like Claude Desktop and Cursor, letting an agent create payment links via natural language in one session; however, there is no documented 'Products' or catalog/price object analogous to Stripe's Product/Price resources — Mollie's model is payment/payment-link-centric, not product+price+link as a linked chain. missing for 10: an explicit Product and Price API/resource that the agent provisions before generating the payment link, and a hands-on/independent example showing an agent completing product+price+link creation end-to-end in one session.
